backend/main.mo: Main actor for the ICP backend defining all public types (UserEntry, FileMetadata, Notification, Folder, etc.) and including mixins for authorization and blob storage, with user approval state initialization and migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that defines old actor state shapes (including OldUserEntry with a #superAdmin status) and runs data migrations to transform legacy state into the current schema for access control, user approval, and storage modules.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the post-login routing logic in App.tsx was updated to bypass approval redirects for the hardcoded designated admin principal, with high confidence and linked to test REQ-2.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, page, and hook in the frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark themes, including background, foreground, sidebar, chart, and destructive variants.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the React app titled 'CloudStorage', mounting the app into a #root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes, handles authentication and approval flow, and includes a hardcoded designated admin principal bypass that routes directly to the app without going through pending/rejected approval pages.
frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx: React component that displays a scrollable list of recent file activities (upload, download, delete) with icons and relative timestamps, showing loading and empty states as appropriate.
frontend/src/components/BulkDeleteDialog: Alert dialog for bulk-deleting multiple files, allowing users to select a retention period (30/60/90 days) before moving files to trash.
Dialog for sharing multiple selected files with another user by entering their principal ID and configuring view/edit/download permissions.
Full-screen error UI displayed on backend connection timeout, offering retry and page-refresh actions.
frontend/src/components/CreateFolderDial: Dialog for creating a new folder (or subfolder) by entering a name, using the useCreateFolder mutation with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/DeleteConfirmati: Alert dialog that confirms permanent deletion of one or more trash items, showing item names and a destructive confirm button.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFileDialog: Dialog for moving a single file to trash, letting the user choose a custom retention period (default 30 days) before confirming.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderConf: Alert dialog for permanently deleting one or more folders from trash, warning that all contained files and subfolders will also be irreversibly deleted.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderDial: Dialog for moving a single folder to trash via the useDeleteFolderToTrash mutation, noting that contained files will be moved to root level.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderToTr: A dialog component that lets users move a folder to Trash with a selectable retention period (30, 60, or 90 days), converting the chosen days to nanoseconds before calling the onConfirm callback.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React class-based error boundary that catches runtime errors and displays a fallback UI with options to retry or reload the page, showing error details in development mode.
frontend/src/components/FileFilterDropdo: A dropdown component providing filter controls for files by name, type, date range, and size range, displaying an active filter count badge and a clear-all option.
frontend/src/components/FileList.tsx: A comprehensive file and folder list component that integrates search, filtering, sorting, pagination, and per-row actions (preview, delete, rename, move, favorite, folder protection) with bulk selection support.
frontend/src/components/FilePreview.tsx: A full-screen file preview component that renders images, videos, PDFs, and text files from raw binary data, with a download button and close control.
A debounced search input component (300ms delay) with a clear button, used for filtering files by name or type.
frontend/src/components/FileSortDropdown: A dropdown component for sorting files by name, date, size, or type, displaying the current sort field and direction with checkmarks and arrow icons.
frontend/src/components/FileToolbar.tsx: Renders a toolbar combining search input, filter dropdown, sort dropdown, and grid/list view toggle for the file browser. Accepts and forwards all relevant state and handler props to child components.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: Provides a drag-and-drop and click-to-browse file upload UI that uploads selected files to an optional folder, shows progress, and records recent uploads via context.
frontend/src/components/FolderActionPass: Modal dialog that prompts for a folder's password before allowing a specific action, enforcing a 5-attempt lockout stored in sessionStorage using SHA-256 hashing.
frontend/src/components/FolderBreadcrumb: Renders a recursive breadcrumb navigation bar for the current folder hierarchy, fetching each ancestor folder by ID and allowing navigation to any level.
frontend/src/components/FolderPasswordPr: Modal dialog for entering a password to access a protected folder, with a 5-attempt lockout and an activity-alert notification sent on lockout via the backend.
frontend/src/components/FolderProtection: Modal for managing folder password protection, allowing users to set, change, or remove a password and toggle a lock state, with SHA-256 hashing and current-password verification.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders the app's sticky top navigation bar with logo, search, notification bell with unread badge, dark/light theme toggle, and a user avatar dropdown menu with logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Defines the main page layout composing the Header, Sidebar, and an Outlet for nested routes, wrapped in an ErrorBoundary.
frontend/src/components/LoadingTimeout.t: Wraps children and shows a timeout error UI with a refresh button if the loading state exceeds a configurable duration (default 45 seconds).
frontend/src/components/MoveFolderDialog: Dialog for moving a folder to a new parent destination, filtering out the folder's own descendants from selectable targets and showing a confirmation step before executing the move.
frontend/src/components/MoveToFolderDial: Dialog that lets users select a destination folder via a radio group and move one or more files there using the move-files mutation.
frontend/src/components/Notifications.ts: Displays a scrollable list of user notifications with type-specific icons and text, and provides mark-as-read and mark-all-read actions.
frontend/src/components/PaginationContro: Reusable pagination UI component that renders page navigation buttons, ellipsis, and an items-per-page selector with range info display.
frontend/src/components/PinnedFiles.tsx: Displays a horizontally scrollable list of user-favorited/pinned files with name and size, fetched via `useGetFavorites`, with loading skeletons and error/empty states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Renders a first-time profile setup form (name + optional email) that saves the user profile via `useSaveCallerUserProfile` and calls `onProfileSaved` on success.
frontend/src/components/QuickActions.tsx: Provides three quick-action buttons—upload files, create a folder, and create a text document—wiring file input, upload mutation, and folder dialog together.
frontend/src/components/RecentActivityCa: Shows a scrollable list of recent file activities (upload, download, share, delete) fetched via `useGetRecentActivities`, with loading skeletons and empty/error states.
frontend/src/components/RenameFileDialog: Dialog for renaming a file; currently shows an informative error toast because the backend rename endpoint is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/components/RenameFolderDial: Dialog that allows renaming a folder by calling `useRenameFolder` mutation, with inline validation and success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/RestoreDialog.ts: Dialog for restoring one or more trashed items, letting the user choose between restoring to the original location or a custom folder path.
frontend/src/components/SharedByMe.tsx: Displays a paginated, searchable table of files the current user has shared, with per-item and bulk revoke functionality using the revokeShare mutation.
frontend/src/components/SharedWithMe.tsx: Displays a paginated, searchable table of files shared with the current user, with multi-select and clipboard copy of selected file names.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Renders the app's collapsible left navigation sidebar with main nav links, settings/admin links, and an admin-only panel link, plus a storage quota indicator at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/SmartSuggestions: Fetches and renders up to five AI-driven file suggestions with loading skeletons, error, and empty states.
Shows a card with a labeled progress bar visualizing used vs. total storage quota, color-coded by usage percentage.
frontend/src/components/StorageQuotaIndi: Compact sidebar widget displaying a thin progress bar and text summary of used/total storage quota.
frontend/src/components/TrashFilters.tsx: Provides a search input and a popover filter panel (owner, min/max size) for filtering trash items, with an active-filter count badge.
frontend/src/components/TrashStorageIndi: Displays a card showing how much storage is used by trash, including size and percentage of total quota, with a loading skeleton state.
frontend/src/components/UserStorageManag: Admin component that lists all users' storage usage with progress bars and allows inline editing of each user's storage quota in GB.
frontend/src/contexts/RecentUploadsConte: React context that tracks recently uploaded files in memory, providing add and clear operations via a custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using TanStack Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileFilters.ts: Hook managing file filter state (name, type, date range, size range) and exposing a memoized function to apply those filters to a list of FileMetadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSearch.ts: Hook that maintains a search query string and provides a memoized function to filter FileMetadata by file name or extension.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSorting.ts: Hook managing sort field and order state, exposing a memoized function to sort FileMetadata by name, date, size, or type.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook that manage ICP AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout, and expose identity and status to the component tree.
frontend/src/hooks/usePagination.ts: Generic pagination hook that tracks current page and items-per-page state, providing a function to slice any data array to the current page's items.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines local TypeScript types (TrashMetadata, Notification, SharedFileInfo, etc.) and exports React Query hooks for querying and mutating backend data including admin checks, approvals, favorites, and file operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` utility function that merges Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status and renders summary stat cards alongside UserStorageManager and ActivityFeed components, showing access-denied UI for non-admins.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page for managing user approvals, featuring a searchable table of users with approve/reject actions, confirmation dialogs, and status badges.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main file dashboard page with folder navigation breadcrumbs, collapsible file upload area, file list, and a create-folder dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Favorites.tsx: Favorites page that displays the user's starred files in a card grid with options to remove favorites and preview file contents.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Dashboard home page displaying storage overview, quick actions, pinned files, recent activity, notifications, and smart suggestions in a grid layout wrapped in a RecentUploadsProvider context.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page that presents CloudStorage branding and feature highlights alongside an Internet Identity sign-in button using the useInternetIdentity hook.
frontend/src/pages/PendingApprovalPage.t: Page shown to users whose accounts are awaiting admin approval, with options to refresh status, request approval, or log out; redirects to a rejected view if the user's approval status is rejected.
frontend/src/pages/Recent.tsx: Recent files page that lists uploaded files with search, filter, sort, and pagination support, allowing users to preview or delete files in card or row view.
frontend/src/pages/RejectedPage.tsx: Page displayed when a user's account request has been denied, informing them of the rejection and providing a sign-out button.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page allowing users to view account info, configure trash retention period, and toggle the application theme (light/dark/system).
frontend/src/pages/Shared.tsx: Shared files page with two tabs—'Shared With Me' and 'Shared By Me'—rendering the corresponding SharedWithMe and SharedByMe components.
frontend/src/pages/Trash.tsx: React page component for the Trash view that displays deleted files and folders in a tabbed table layout with support for search, pagination, bulk selection, restore, and permanent deletion actions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read URL/hash query parameters, persist them to sessionStorage, and clean sensitive parameters from the URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius variables, accordion keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the CloudStorage ICP app, its hardcoded admin principal, existing routing features, and a pending backend task to always treat that principal as an approved admin.
